overview_description.description:
Alkira Network is a developer of a network cloud that allows businesses to build and position multi-cloud network-as-a-service in minutes.

The company's Network Cloud reinvents networking for the cloud era with hybrid and multi-cloud network connectivity, integrated network and security services, end-to-end day-2 operational visibility, advanced controls, and governance. Alkira Network Cloud is based on Alkira Cloud Services Exchange™ solution with a global unified network infrastructure delivered as-a-service for easy and simple consumption. Just draw the network across users, sites, and clouds on an intuitive digital design canvas, provision it in one click, and start using it in minutes. Alkira’s solution is used by Fortune-100 enterprises, leading system integrators, and managed service providers.

Amir Khan and Atif Khan established the company in San Jose, California in 2018.

about_short_description.short_description: Alkira is a network infrastructure as-a-service company that unifies multiple clouds, sites, and users via an enterprise network.

product.name: Alkira Network Infrastructure-as-a-Service Platform
product.description: A cloud-delivered networking platform that connects clouds, data centers, sites, users, partners, and AI workloads through centralized control, policy, security, and visibility.

product.name: Multicloud Optimization
product.description: A unified connectivity service for linking workloads across single-cloud, multicloud, hybrid-cloud, data-center, branch, and private-network environments with consistent routing, segmentation, security, and visibility.

product.name: Integrated Security and Network Services
product.description: A policy-driven service that combines network connectivity with firewall insertion, SASE integrations, load balancing, DNS, DHCP, and IP address management across cloud and on-premises environments.

product.name: Global Backbone-as-a-Service
product.description: An on-demand global network backbone that provides encrypted, high-bandwidth connectivity among cloud regions, data centers, WANs, and edge environments through Alkira Cloud Exchange Points.

product.name: Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA)
product.description: A network access service that applies identity-based, least-privilege access and segmentation to users, applications, workloads, and partners across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

product.name: Instant Extranet
product.description: A governed partner-connectivity service that automates segmented access to applications and networks, including support for overlapping IP addresses, private connectivity, and policy-based traffic visibility.
